dedupe_keys.name: watergap 2 2e streamflow calibration and evaluation data

description: This WaterGAP 2.2e collection merges streamflow records from GRDC, GSIM and ADHI for 1,509 stations and co-registers them to the DDM30 drainage grid. Goethe University Frankfurt and Senckenberg researchers supply monthly series for evaluation, selected annual series for calibration, station points and basin outlines. The files cover 1901 to 2021 with station-dependent availability. Calibration uses no more than 30 complete years per station, preferably within 1981 to 2010. ZIP packages contain JSON records and ESRI shapefiles; streamflow values are in cubic metres per second. Access is free under CC-BY-SA-3.0, which the README attributes to the GSIM share-alike requirement. Modellers can use the data to calibrate or evaluate water-resource simulations. A limitation is that stations and periods were selected for WaterGAP, including minimum catchment-size and completeness criteria, so the package is not an unfiltered gauge archive. It is a companion to WaterGAP; version 1.1 changes shapefile packaging. No observations were downloaded or checked against simulations.
